events.headline: Series A: $124M led by Jaan Tallinn
events.summary: Anthropic announced a $124M Series A led by Jaan Tallinn with James McClave, Dustin Moskovitz, the Center for Emerging Risk Research and Eric Schmidt; PitchBook adds a $337M pre / $461M post-money valuation and a $51.3121 pre-split price per share.

source.title: Anthropic raises $124 million to build more reliable, general AI systems

other.announced_vs_closed: announced=closed 2021-05-28 (PB status Completed)

events.notes: Round size confirmed by T1 (Anthropic, opened) and PB. Anthropic states no valuation; $337M pre / $461M post is PitchBook-only (T2, 'Actual' status) and is arithmetic-consistent (337+124=461; 124/461=26.9% = PB percent acquired). Price $51.3121 is on the pre-split basis (PB row shows 1:1; the 20:1 split appears on the Series B row), i.e. about $2.5656 split-adjusted (my arithmetic). Wikipedia's 2021 TechCrunch citation could not be independently opened by this agent.

events.headline: Series B announced: $580M led by Sam Bankman-Fried
events.summary: Anthropic announced a $580M Series B led by FTX CEO Sam Bankman-Fried with Caroline Ellison, Jim McClave, Nishad Singh, Jaan Tallinn and CERR, at a time the company had about 40 employees; no valuation was given.

source.title: Anthropic raises Series B to build safe, reliable AI

corroboration.publisher: Anthropic (Series B page; also opened for employee count)

other.announced_vs_closed: announced 2022-04-29; PB records $980M (see evt-20220429-pb-series-b-980m-reconcile)

events.notes: HIGH for the announced $580M (T1 opened + VentureBeat). Announced figure does NOT equal PitchBook's $980M Series B - see reconciliation event and conflicts. No valuation in T1. Employee count ~40 (T1).

events.headline: PitchBook records Series B at $980M, $3.0B post-money
events.summary: PitchBook's Series B record (2022-04-29) shows $980M, $2.02B pre / $3.0B post-money and $11.2261 per share on a 20:1 split-adjusted basis, $400M above the $580M Anthropic announced.

source.title: PitchBook deal record: Series B

corroboration.publisher: CourtListener RECAP index of FTX docket (Anthropic share-sale notices)

other.announced_vs_closed: PB 'Completed' 2022-04-29; press announced $580M

events.notes: DISPUTED: PB $980M vs T1 $580M (gap $400M, +69%). Pre/post and announced/closed do not explain it: pre+size=post holds inside PB, and shares x price = 87.30M x $11.2261 = $980M, so PB models a single 87.3M-share Series B at one price. Most plausible (unverified) reading: PB aggregates later Series B-priced closings on top of the April 2022 $580M; a $400M delta is the same order as Google's Feb-2023 investment (FT: $300M for ~10%; $300M/$3.0B post = 10%), but PB does not list Google in the Series B investor list and first dates Alphabet at the 2023-06-30 Series C (investors file), so the link is NOT established. Resolution needs PB deal participants/cap table or the S-1 capitalization table. FTX-estate filing: 29,465,891 of its ~44.5M shares were sold in Mar 2024 at $30.0045 (see FTX event); 44.54M shares x $11.2261 = $500M matches the DOJ-stated ~$500M, supporting the $11.2261 Series B price.

events.headline: DOJ letter: Bankman-Fried invested ~$500M in Anthropic in 2022
events.summary: A DOJ letter in US v. Bankman-Fried (Dkt. 315, filed 2023-10-08) states the defendant 'invested approximately $500 million in 2022' in Anthropic using funds the Government alleges were stolen from FTX customers.

source.publisher: U.S. Attorney SDNY via CourtListener RECAP
source.title: Letter re: motion in limine, United States v. Bankman-Fried, 22 Cr. 673 (LAK), Doc. 315

corroboration.publisher: CNBC via NBC New York ('company originally invested $500 million')

other.announced_vs_closed: 2022 investment (Series B); no closing date in letter

events.notes: Primary-source (court filing, PDF text extracted locally) confirmation that the FTX-side Series B cheque was ~$500M in 2022, i.e. ~86% of the $580M announced round. Does not state the date (Protos/AFP dating to Oct 2021 is a scout-2021-2022 conflict; not re-examined here).

events.headline: Google reportedly invests $300M for ~10% of Anthropic
events.summary: The Financial Times reported Google invested about $300M in Anthropic for a roughly 10% stake; Fortune (citing the NYT) puts the implied valuation near $5B, and neither company published terms.

source.title: Google invests $300M in Anthropic as race to compete with ChatGPT heats up

other.announced_vs_closed: reported (FT), terms not confirmed by companies

events.notes: Single FT scoop relayed by Fortune and VentureBeat (FT original paywalled, not opened). Internal inconsistency: $300M for ~10% implies ~$3.0B post-money, not ~$5B (Fortune attributes ~$5B to the NYT). $3.0B equals PitchBook's Series B post-money, which may mean the cheque was priced at the Series B price - unverified inference. Tom's Guide headline cites $400M but the page was truncated in fetch and is not relied on. PB has no separate Feb-2023 Google deal (first dates Alphabet at Series C 2023-06-30).

events.headline: Series C: $450M led by Spark Capital; PB prices at $4.1B pre
events.summary: Anthropic announced a $450M Series C led by Spark Capital with Google, Salesforce Ventures, Sound Ventures, Zoom Ventures and others; PitchBook records the close on 2023-06-30 at $4.1B pre / $4.55B post-money and $11.2261 per share.

source.title: Anthropic raises $450 million in Series C funding

corroboration.publisher: TechCrunch (valuation framing: 'over-$4.1 billion' per The Information; total raised $1.45B)
TechCrunch (Sep 25 2023: 'valued at about $5 billion in May')

other.announced_vs_closed: announced 2023-05-23 (T1); PB close date 2023-06-30 (Series C-1 and C-2)

events.notes: Round size HIGH (T1 + PB exactly $450.0M). Valuation MEDIUM: Anthropic never disclosed it. PB pre-money $4.1B equals The Information's 'over-$4.1B' valuation (TechCrunch: reported in March while raising), so that figure is a pre-money/seeking number; PB post-money is $4.55B and the later press '~$5B' is 9% above it (<10% threshold) - the apparent $4.1B vs ~$5B dispute is largely pre- vs post-money plus press rounding, not a true conflict. PB lists Microsoft, SK Telecom, SAP among 39 investors (T1 names only Google, Salesforce Ventures, Sound, Zoom). TechCrunch total raised after C = $1.45B vs PB $1.554B (-$104M).

events.headline: SK Telecom invests additional $100M in Anthropic
events.summary: SK Telecom announced an additional US$100M investment in Anthropic, following an earlier SKTVC investment, alongside a multilingual telco LLM partnership.

source.title: SK Telecom press release (idx 1576)

other.announced_vs_closed: announced; funding date not stated

events.notes: Amount and 'additional' language confirmed by the T1 release (opened). Whether the $100M sits inside PitchBook's $450M Series C (SKT is a listed Series C investor) or is incremental is not determinable: PB Series C equals exactly $450M, T1 Series C says $450M, and TechCrunch's post-C total ($1.45B) vs PB ($1.554B) differ by ~$104M, which is suggestive but not proof that PB counts the $100M separately. No valuation disclosed.

events.headline: Amazon to invest up to $4B; first $1.25B as convertible note

source.title: Amazon and Anthropic announce strategic collaboration to advance generative AI

other.announced_vs_closed: up-to-$4B announced; $1.25B funded Q3 2023 (convertible note); $2.75B option expiring Q1 2024
other.pitchbook_deal_id: 276864-04T (PB folds Amazon into a single 2024-11-22 round)

events.notes: 'Up to $4B' is not funded capital: 10-Q (verbatim): 'in September 2023 we invested in a $1.25 billion note from Anthropic, PBC, which is convertible to equity. We have an agreement that expires in Q1 2024 to invest up to an additional $2.75 billion in a second convertible note.' Instrument = convertible debt, not priced equity. No valuation disclosed. TechCrunch: Anthropic had $2.7B total funding before this and was 'valued at about $5B in May'.

events.headline: Google invests $500M upfront, up to $2B total, in Anthropic
events.summary: Reuters, citing the WSJ, reported Google invested $500M upfront in Anthropic and agreed to add $1.5B over time, with Anthropic confirming; PitchBook books the full $2.0B on 2023-10-27, noting it began as convertible debt and converted to equity.

source.title: Google agrees to invest up to $2 billion in OpenAI rival Anthropic

corroboration.publisher: PitchBook (deal 242653-24T: $2,000M, 'originally convertible debt... converted to equity')

other.announced_vs_closed: $500M upfront + $1.5B 'over time' (Reuters); PB dates all $2.0B at 2023-10-27

events.notes: Up-to vs funded: PB's $2.0B equals the 'up to' cap, but only $500M was funded at signing (Reuters). Instrument (convertible notes) is from PB's synopsis, not from Reuters. DOJ-filing coverage (Mar 2025) says Google had invested >$3B by then and planned another $750M convertible in 2025, so PB's $2.0B plausibly UNDER-counts Google's total funded cash (see evt-20250311). Google and Amazon valuations not disclosed. Alphabet's 10-K FY2025 and Q2-2026 10-Q (opened) do not name Anthropic.

events.headline: Reported talks: $750M Menlo-led round at $15B pre-money
events.summary: Reuters, citing The Information, reported Anthropic was in talks to raise $750M led by Menlo Ventures at a $15B valuation excluding the new money, while Crunchbase News relayed CNBC's report of an $18.4B valuation.

source.title: Anthropic to raise $750 mln in round led by Menlo Ventures - The Information

corroboration.publisher: Crunchbase News (Dec 21, 2023; CNBC $18.4B; total raised $7.6B per Crunchbase)

other.announced_vs_closed: talks (not final)

events.notes: Talks-stage. $15.0B pre + $0.75B = $15.75B post, which is 14% below the $18.4B/'above $18B' figure, so pre/post does not reconcile the two press numbers; Reuters itself says 'final valuation could go above $18 billion'. Closed later (Series D; see evt-20240513 and evt-20240701). Crunchbase's $7.6B 'total funding' at this date counts Amazon/Google commitments (basis differs from PB).

events.headline: FTX estate sells 29.47M Anthropic shares for $884.1M
events.summary: A notice filed in FTX's Delaware bankruptcy (Doc 10241-1, 2024-03-22) lists 29,465,891 Anthropic shares sold to ~25 purchasers for $884,109,327 ($30.0045 per share), led by ATIC Third International at $500.0M and Jane Street at $100.0M.

source.publisher: U.S. Bankruptcy Court D. Del., In re FTX Trading Ltd., No. 22-11068 (JTD), Doc. 10241-1 via CourtListener RECAP
source.title: Exhibit 1: List of Purchasers, Number of Shares and Aggregate Purchase Price

corroboration.publisher: CNBC via NBC New York (Mar 25, 2024: $884M, 'nearly two-thirds' of FTX's shares; court approval pending)

other.announced_vs_closed: notice of proposed sale 2024-03-22; court approval to sell authorized ~2024-02-22 per headlines (unopened)
other.pitchbook_deal_id: 252783-46T (PB $1,320M record combines this and the June 2024 tranche)

events.notes: Primary source read in full (PDF text extracted locally): total 29,465,891 shares / $884,109,327 => $30.0045/share, identical to PitchBook's Series D price per share ($30.0045), so the sale was struck at the Series D price. 29.47M = 'nearly two-thirds' of FTX's ~44.5M shares (Protos: 44,539,240). Class/series of shares not stated in the exhibit. Note: Anthropic later said it does not permit SPVs to acquire its stock (TechCrunch May 12 2026), yet this list includes vehicles such as Hiive Anthropic Series I/II and Fund FG-BLU - flag for governance/legal.

events.headline: Amazon completes $4B: adds $2.75B second convertible note
events.summary: Amazon said it made its additional $2.75B investment, bringing its total in Anthropic to $4B for a minority stake; its later 10-Q confirms the second note was funded in Q1 2024.

source.title: Amazon and Anthropic... additional $2.75 billion investment

corroboration.publisher: Amazon Form 10-Q (Q1 2025): 'In Q1 2024, we invested $2.75 billion in a second convertible note'

other.announced_vs_closed: funded Q1 2024 (T1 10-Q)

events.notes: Instrument = second convertible note (10-Q), not stated in the Amazon post or TechCrunch. No valuation or stake % disclosed. Cumulative Amazon notes after this: $4.0B.

events.headline: TechCrunch: Anthropic at $18.4B post-money, raising more primary capital
events.summary: TechCrunch reported on 2024-05-13 that Anthropic had raised nearly $8B in total, valued at $18.4B post-money, and was 'in the process of raising more primary capital'; Menlo's 2026 retrospective says it led a $750M+ Series D via an SPV at an '$18 billion' valuation.

source.title: Anthropic is expanding to Europe and raising more money

corroboration.publisher: TechCrunch (Jun 23 2026): Menlo led Series D, $750M+, via SPV; Series D valuation $18B; Menlo stake ~$14B

other.announced_vs_closed: initial Menlo-led close reported Jan 2024 (Forbes Jan 11 2024 - 403, unopened); later D closings to PB's 2024-07-01

events.notes: Explicit 'post-money' wording only for $18.4B (TechCrunch) - no official Anthropic release for the Series D exists. 'Nearly $8B raised' is a commitments-inclusive total (Amazon $4B + Google $2B + prior rounds), cf. PB $3.55B at that date. The FTX sale at $30.0045/share (T1, Mar 2024) and PB's Series D price are the same, so press and PB describe the same price but different share counts: $18.4B/30.0045 = 613M FD shares vs PB's 700M (21.0B/30.0045) - a fully-diluted-basis difference (my arithmetic), not a price difference.

events.headline: PitchBook: Series D closes at $1.2B, $21.0B post-money
events.summary: PitchBook records Series D (D-1, D-2, D-3; led by Menlo Ventures, 43 investors) at $1.2B on 2024-07-01 with $19.8B pre / $21.0B post-money and $30.0045 per share, versus the $750M / $18.4B reported in press.

source.title: PitchBook deal record: Series D

corroboration.publisher: FTX estate sale at $30.0045/share (T1) - same price as PB Series D

other.announced_vs_closed: PB close 2024-07-01 (aggregate of D-1/D-2/D-3); press cites initial $750M

events.notes: DISPUTED (size +60%, post-money +14% vs press). Arithmetic inside PB is consistent (40.44M sh x $30.0045 = $1.213B; 19.8+1.2=21.0; 700M FD shares). The price per share matches T1 (FTX docket), so the valuation gap is a fully-diluted share-count basis difference (PB 700M vs 613M implied by $18.4B) and the $450M size gap is later D closings (D-2/D-3) - both consistent with 'announced vs closed', but unverified by any opened Anthropic document (no Anthropic release for Series D exists). Retail vehicles (Fundrise, MicroVentures) appear among 43 investors.

events.headline: Amazon commits another $4B (total $8B); PB books $8B round at $54B post
events.summary: Amazon announced an additional $4B investment (total $8B, minority position); Amazon's 10-Q shows only $1.3B was funded in Q4 2024 with $2.7B more due by Q4 2025, while PitchBook books the full $8B on 2024-11-22 at $46B pre / $54B post and $53.2822 per share.

source.title: Amazon to invest additional $4 billion in Anthropic

corroboration.publisher: TechCrunch (Nov 22 2024: Anthropic has raised $13.7B in VC to date)
Amazon 10-Q Q1 2025: Q4 2024 $1.3B third note; $2.7B more by Q4 2025

events.notes: Commitment $4B / total $8B: HIGH (T1 + TechCrunch). PitchBook's 6th round consolidates Amazon's ENTIRE $8B (Sep-2023 to Q4-2025 notes) at one date and price; funded by Nov 2024 was $5.3B (Amazon 10-Q). PB also calls $8B 'equity' (only $1.3B described as converted debt) whereas Amazon's 10-Q says all $8.0B were convertible notes, partly converted to preferred in Q1'25/Q3'25. PB's 298.7M 'shares acquired' x $53.2822 = $15.9B (1.99x the $8B) and 29.48% 'percent acquired' vs 14.8% size/post - PB share/ownership fields for this row do not reconcile to deal size. Valuation $46B pre/$54B post is PB-only (Amazon and Anthropic disclose none); TechCrunch mentions a $40B valuation discussed for months.

events.headline: FTX estate sells remaining ~15M Anthropic shares for ~$452M
events.summary: Bitcoinist, citing FTX estate filings on Kroll, reported the estate sold its remaining 15 million Anthropic shares at about $30 each for roughly $452M, with G Squared taking 4.5M shares (~$135M), bringing total proceeds from both sales to about $1.3B on a $500M cost.

source.title: FTX Offloads Remaining Anthropic Shares In $450 Million Sale

other.announced_vs_closed: reported June 2024 (estate filings via Kroll); court docket entries for this tranche not found on CourtListener

events.notes: Single T3 crypto outlet relaying estate filings (CCN Jun 3 and The Block Jun 1 headlines seen in RSS/search but CCN returned 403; not relied on). Arithmetic: sale 1 (T1) $884.1M + this $452M = $1,336M vs PB's $1,320M (1.2% gap); 29.47M + ~15.07M = ~44.5M shares = FTX's ~44.5M Series B shares (Protos via scout; unopened). Price ~$30 = Series D price, i.e. both estate sales were at $30.0045, well below later rounds (Series E $56.09). Headline cost $500M vs ~$1.3B proceeds.

events.headline: PitchBook secondary: FTX/Alameda stake sold for $1.32B

source.title: PitchBook deal record: Secondary Transaction - Private

other.announced_vs_closed: PB date 2024-05-31; actual court-notice date of sale 1 = 2024-03-22

events.notes: Amount reconciles within 1.2% to the two estate sales ($884.1M T1 + ~$452M T3 = ~$1,336M). Conflicts: (1) PB's buyer list (SquareOne, DAMAC, Bessemer, Golden Falcon, AGC, Pachamama) does not match the T1 purchaser list for sale 1 (ATIC, Jane Street, Fidelity, HOF, Ford...; only Jane Street overlaps); (2) PB 'shares acquired' 29.4M equals sale 1 only while the $1.32B spans both sales; (3) date 2024-05-31 sits between Mar-22 (notice) and ~Jun-2 (sale 2 report). Treat PB's record as a blended estimate. Secondary = no cash to Anthropic; excluded from total raised.

events.summary: Court filings in the DOJ v. Google antitrust case, reported by the NYT and relayed by TechCrunch, show Google owns 14% of Anthropic with no voting rights, board seats or control, has invested more than $3B and planned another $750M in convertible debt in 2025.

other.announced_vs_closed: 14% as of filing date; $750M convertible 'planned for 2025'

Alphabet's FY2025 10-K and Q2-2026 10-Q (SEC, opened) never name Anthropic or state an ownership %; Yahoo/Motley Fool (Sep 24 2026) says Alphabet 'has never said what percentage of Anthropic it owns'. 14% in Mar 2025 is pre-Series F/G/H dilution.

events.headline: Anthropic's first employee share buyback at $61.5B valuation
events.summary: Maginative, citing The Information, reported Anthropic's first employee buyback at a $61.5B valuation and $56.09 per share, covering up to 20% of each holder's equity capped at $2M for staff with at least two years' tenure, expected to close in late May 2025.

corroboration.publisher: PitchBook Series E price $56.0865 (= buyback price $56.09)

other.announced_vs_closed: launched 2025-05-02; expected close end-May 2025; total size undisclosed

events.notes: Upgraded from VERIFY because the $56.09 price matches PitchBook's Series E price per share ($56.0865) - an independent numerical check of the paywalled The Information figure. Total buyback size not stated ('hundreds of millions'). Company-funded buyback (cash out of Anthropic) - reduces cash, not counted in total raised. Run-rate ($1.4B) and headcount (800+) figures in the piece are outside this desk's scope and conflict with company-stated figures (see scouts).

events.headline: Amazon 10-Q: $5.3B funded in notes; partial conversion to preferred, $3.3B gain
events.summary: Amazon's Q1 2025 10-Q shows $1.25B (Q3 2023), $2.75B (Q1 2024) and $1.3B (Q4 2024) of Anthropic convertible notes with $2.7B more due by Q4 2025, a partial conversion to nonvoting preferred in Q1 2025, a ~$3.3B gain and ~$13.8B fair value.

source.publisher: SEC EDGAR - Amazon.com, Inc. Form 10-Q (quarter ended 2025-03-31)
source.title: Form 10-Q, Note 2 - Financial Instruments

events.notes: Verbatim: 'In Q3 2023, we invested in a $1.25 billion note... In Q1 2024, we invested $2.75 billion in a second convertible note... In Q4 2024, we entered into an agreement and invested $1.3 billion in a third convertible note, and will invest an additional $2.7 billion by Q4 2025.' Fair value of notes+preferred ~$13.8B at both 12/31/24 and 3/31/25. Establishes that only $5.3B of the '$8B' was funded when PitchBook booked $8B (Nov 2024).

events.headline: Anthropic closes $2.5B five-year revolving credit facility

source.title: Anthropic raises $2.5B in debt to finance growth investments

source.title: Anthropic raises Series F at $183B post-money valuation

events.headline: Amazon 10-Q: Anthropic notes total $8.0B; preferred $14.8B, notes at $23.7B
events.summary: Amazon's Q3 2025 10-Q shows $5.3B of notes funded Q3 2023-Q4 2024, $1.3B in Q2 2025 and $1.4B due Q4 2025, nonvoting preferred carried at ~$14.8B and notes at ~$23.7B fair value, and a $9.5B quarter gain ($2.3B conversion + $7.2B uplift).

source.publisher: SEC EDGAR - Amazon.com, Inc. Form 10-Q (quarter ended 2025-09-30)
source.title: Form 10-Q, Note 2 - Financial Instruments

events.notes: Verbatim: 'From Q3 2023 to Q4 2024, we invested $5.3 billion in convertible notes from Anthropic'; 'In Q2 2025, we invested $1.3 billion in a new convertible note'; 'will invest an additional $1.4 billion in Q4 2025'. Arithmetic 1.25+2.75+1.3+1.3+1.4 = $8.0B, matching the Q2 2026 10-Q's 'From Q3 2023 to Q4 2025, we invested $8.0 billion in convertible notes'. Gain attributed to conversions and 'observable price changes' (Series F).

events.headline: Microsoft (up to $5B) and NVIDIA (up to $10B) commit to invest
events.summary: Anthropic announced that NVIDIA and Microsoft are committing to invest up to $10B and up to $5B respectively, alongside a $30B Azure compute commitment and up to 1 GW of NVIDIA capacity.

source.title: Microsoft, NVIDIA and Anthropic announce strategic partnerships

corroboration.publisher: Microsoft FY26 Q4 earnings release, SEC EDGAR ($3.2B gain from Anthropic investment)

other.announced_vs_closed: 'up to' caps; funded amounts undisclosed; 'a portion' inside Series G (T1 Feb 12 2026)

events.notes: HIGH for the announced caps (T1). Funded amounts are NOT disclosed: Microsoft's FY2026 10-K and NVIDIA's Jul-2026 10-Q (SEC, opened) do not name Anthropic in the text processed (NVIDIA: 'committed to make certain equity investments in AI model makers... subject to certain contingencies'; $51.2B non-marketable securities). No valuation in the T1 post; ~$350B appears in press. 'Up to' amounts must not be added to total raised: Anthropic's Series G release says G 'includes a portion of the previously announced investments from Microsoft and NVIDIA'.

events.headline: FT: Anthropic hires Wilson Sonsini, sounds out banks for 2026 IPO
events.summary: Reuters relayed an FT report that Anthropic hired Wilson Sonsini and held early informal talks with banks about an IPO as early as 2026 while negotiating a private round above $300B, with Anthropic saying it had not decided when or whether to list.

source.title: Anthropic plans IPO as early as 2026 - FT

other.announced_vs_closed: reported; unconfirmed by Anthropic

events.notes: FT original paywalled; Reuters wire (Dec 2, US evening) used; TechCrunch/Fortune are Dec 3. PitchBook already lists Wilson Sonsini as company counsel on the Nov-2024 and Feb-2026 rounds (deal records 276864-04T and 313890-49T), so 'hired for IPO' is a role change, not a new relationship. Run-rate projection ~$26B for 2026 in the same report is out of scope.

events.headline: Series G first reported at $10B (WSJ), upsized to $20B by Feb 9
events.summary: TechCrunch, citing the WSJ, reported Anthropic was raising $10B at a $350B valuation led by Coatue and GIC, then on Feb 9 said demand had doubled the raise to $20B at $350B with Altimeter, Sequoia, Lightspeed, Menlo, Coatue, ICONIQ and GIC among investors.

source.title: Anthropic reportedly raising $10B at $350B valuation

other.announced_vs_closed: term-sheet stage Jan 7 ($10B); ~closing Feb 9 ($20B); announced Feb 12 ($30B)

events.notes: Path of the round: $10B (Jan 7) -> $20B (Feb 9) -> $30B announced (Feb 12). The $350B figure is the PRE-money of the final round ($380B post - $30B); the fetch summary of the Jan 7 article labelled it post-money, which Anthropic's Feb 12 numbers contradict (pre/post mislabel, not a dispute). Jan 7 said the round was separate from the $15B Nvidia/Microsoft commitment and Feb 9 said those two supplied 'the bulk'; Anthropic's release says only 'a portion' - scope difference.

events.headline: Bloomberg: Anthropic plans employee tender at $350B pre-money
events.summary: Aggregator relays of a Bloomberg scoop said Anthropic planned a tender offer letting current and former employees sell at a $350B pre-money valuation alongside a funding round of more than $20B, with investors assembling the secondary capital and Anthropic declining comment.

source.title: Anthropic said to plan tender offer at $350 billion valuation

other.announced_vs_closed: planned (Feb 2026); RSS headlines: launched ~Feb 23 'up to $6 billion' (unopened), completed Apr 8

events.notes: Two T4 aggregators of a paywalled Bloomberg scoop (Bloomberg 403). $350B equals the Series G pre-money, so the tender was struck at the same price as the primary. Size is 'depends on how many shares employees sell'. The 'up to $6B' and Feb 23 launch appear only in RSS headlines.

events.headline: Series G: $30B at $380B post-money, led by GIC and Coatue
events.summary: Anthropic announced a $30B Series G at a $380B post-money valuation led by GIC and Coatue, co-led by D. E. Shaw Ventures, Dragoneer, Founders Fund, ICONIQ and MGX, including a portion of Microsoft and NVIDIA's earlier commitments, with $14B run-rate revenue.

source.title: Anthropic raises $30 billion in Series G funding at $380 billion post-money valuation

other.announced_vs_closed: announced = PB close 2026-02-12

events.notes: T1 + TechCrunch + Reuters + PB agree ($30B/$380B; pre-money $350B derived). PB price $259.1364/share is PB-only. PB's synopsis lists SoftBank among leads and contains a garbled token ('Microsofblant'); SoftBank is not in the T1 investor list - treat as PB data noise. PB 'shares acquired' 295.1M x $259.14 = $76.5B (2.55x the $30B) - PB share fields for G include non-cash/other issuance and must not be used to derive size. Amazon's 10-Q says it bought $5.0B of 'Series G nonvoting preferred' in Q2 2026 (see evt-20260731): whether that is inside the $30B or an add-on closing is undisclosed.

events.headline: Bloomberg headline: Anthropic completes tender; employees hold onto shares
events.summary: Google News RSS shows a Bloomberg headline on 2026-04-08 saying Anthropic completed its employee tender offer but employees largely held on to their shares, with aggregator headlines citing an unfilled ~$60B pool.

source.publisher: Google News RSS (Bloomberg.com headline, PitchBook Apr 17 'champagne problem' headline)
source.title: Anthropic Completes Tender Offer, But Employees Hold Onto Shares

other.announced_vs_closed: completed per headline; size/price not opened

events.notes: Headline-only evidence: Bloomberg, PitchBook (403) and aggregator pages not opened; the '$60 billion pool' figure appears only in a biggo.com headline. Included because the tender is part of the secondary-mark trail ($350B, Feb-Apr 2026). Follow-up: The Information (Jun 14) 'OpenAI, Anthropic employees have already cashed out about $14 billion' - headline only.
